name: (Clockwork Creature) Malfunction - Backfire
text: The clockwork rolls a DC 5 Flat check at the start of each of its turns. On a failure, it backfires, dealing 2d6 fire damage in a 15-foot cone, including to itself (DC 0 basic Reflex save save at the standard DC for its level), and is Slowed 1 this turn.
